findings.title: Caught post-spawn cancellation bypasses remaining owned-child handling
preconditions: Popen returned; proc and origin established
Direct child still running with remaining absolute budget
One KeyboardInterrupt reaches outer capture catch outside inner communicate handler
findings.consequence: Failure is recorded, but only poll and pipe close occur; no remaining owned TERM/KILL/drain attempt. No false success claimed.
findings.minimal_fix: Route caught post-spawn failures through one finite phase-tracked owned cleanup path before pipe close, preserving original origin+14/+17/+19/+20 deadlines, accumulated data, at-most-once signals and permanent failure flags.
